result.stdout:
Lunate - a coding agent for the terminal.

Usage:
  lunate -p [--json] [--yolo] <prompt>
                                 run one prompt and print the final answer to stdout;
                                 --json streams every event as one JSON line, --yolo
                                 approves every tool call for this run
  lunate                         start the interactive session on a terminal
                                 commands: /model /setup /new /resume /name /session /compact /mcp /extensions /trust /quit
  lunate --no-extensions         start any mode without loading extensions (their
                                 hooks, widgets and MCP servers are absent; configured
                                 mcp.json servers still run)
  lunate --acp                   serve the Agent Client Protocol over stdio for
                                 editors (nothing but protocol on stdout)
  lunate mcp roslyn              serve the read-only Roslyn C# tools over
                                 stdio to another MCP client (nothing but protocol
                                 on stdout)
  lunate --version               print the version
  lunate --help                  show this help
  lunate --discover <name-or-url>
                                 list an OpenAI-compatible endpoint's models and
                                 print a models.json draft to stdout (nothing is written)
  lunate --update-catalog [--output <path>] [--source <path-or-url>]
                                 fetch models.dev, map it through the one catalog
                                 mapper and write the managed cache
                                 (~/.lunate/models.catalog.json); --output writes the
                                 snapshot elsewhere (scripts/update-models.sh);
                                 --source reads a local snapshot for offline use
  lunate extensions [--json]
                                 list discovered extensions with scope, state,
